::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Planned, from the syllabus"}
Delete this block once the lesson is drafted.

> - Generate it: start at C, add 7 semitones, take modulo 12, repeat. Twelve steps and you are home.
> - Adjacent keys share six of seven notes. That fact drives modulation, chord progressions, and key signatures.
> - Derive the sharp and flat counts for every key from the circle instead of memorising a chart.
>
> **Checkpoint: given any key, you can name its scale, its relative minor, and its two nearest neighbours without a lookup table.**
:::
